transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been dealing with constant, uncontrollable worry about almost everything in my life, and I just can't seem to turn it off. This has been going on for about a year and four months now, and I really need some help managing it.
Do you find yourself driven to perform repetitive behaviors or mental rituals, like checking things constantly or repeating certain words, to help ease these worries?

No, I don't really do things like that. I don't have any repetitive behaviors or mental rituals, like checking things constantly, to ease my mind. The anxious thoughts are just always running in my head, but I don't do those kinds of actions.
Alongside this worry, have you also been experiencing a persistently low or depressed mood, or a loss of interest or pleasure in the things you normally enjoy?
No, I haven't really been feeling depressed or losing interest in my normal activities. It's more that this constant, overwhelming worry is my main struggle, and it just consumes all of my focus.
Along with this constant worry, have you been experiencing physical symptoms like muscle tension, restlessness, feeling easily fatigued, or trouble sleeping?
I haven't really noticed those kinds of physical symptoms, like muscle tension or trouble sleeping. My main struggle is definitely just the constant mental worry that I can't seem to shut off.
Does this constant worry make you feel easily irritable, or do you find it difficult to concentrate on your daily tasks?

Irritability isn't really a big issue for me, but concentrating on my daily tasks is incredibly difficult. Anxious worries constantly intrude into my mind out of nowhere and completely disrupt whatever I'm trying to focus on. It is really frustrating to feel so distracted all the time.
Do you often feel physically restless, keyed up, or on edge, or do you find that you get tired or fatigued very easily?

I'm not really sure about those physical feelings, and I haven't noticed feeling particularly restless or fatigued. For me, it is really just the mental side of the worry that constantly consumes my mind.
Have you struggled with focus, distraction, or organization since childhood, or did these concentration difficulties only start when your worries began?

No, I never struggled with focus or organization during childhood; these concentration difficulties only started when my worries began about a year and a half ago. My focus gets disrupted because anxious thoughts suddenly intrude into my mind and completely interfere with my attention while I'm trying to complete tasks.
What kinds of things do you find yourself worrying about most often? Is it a variety of everyday topics like work, health, and family, or is your worry focused on one specific thing?

It's definitely not just one thing; my worry spreads to almost everything in my life. I find myself constantly stressing over work, my family, finances, and even minor daily tasks. It feels completely out of my control, like my mind is always finding something new to worry about.
How much has this constant worry and difficulty concentrating impacted your ability to function at work, in your relationships, or in other important areas of your life?

It has had a huge impact on my daily life, especially because the worry isn't limited to one thing but spreads to my work, family, and finances. These intrusive thoughts constantly pop up out of nowhere, making it incredibly hard to focus and actually get my tasks done.
Did these worries first start around the time of a specific stressful life event, major change, or difficult situation in your life?

I honestly can't recall any specific stressful event or major life change that triggered these worries. They just seemed to start gradually on their own a little over a year ago, and they have been building up ever since.
